items.title: WFN and HHRD jointly distribute winter relief to Bhotekoshi flood victims
items.summary: Kathmandu, November 19 Work for Nepal has distributed winter relief materials to people affected by August’s Bhotekoshi flood, with support from Helping Hands for Relief and Development (HHRD). The relief was provided under the organisation’s winter relief programme. items.title: Nepal urges China to reopen Tatopani border crossing
items.summary: Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal tells a visiting Chinese delegation that the crossing is crucial to connectivity, as the Rasuwagadhi route remains shut following the August floods.

items.title: Flood victims occupy Nepal Electricity Authority land, erect tents
items.summary: More than 250 displaced families from Trishuli Bazar cleared the land using an excavator, accusing the government of delaying their rehabilitation.
